title: Loupe
description: A Beatles sleeve on a dark desk and a collector's loupe in a low sun. Turn the glass from 2× to 20×: the sun swings round, the lens pulls its light into a burning hot spot with a coloured caustic ring, the sheen slides across the sleeve, and the cover comes apart into CMYK rosettes.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: real glass with refraction, chromatic fringe and a focused caustic over a real print, where magnification turns a cover into the ink it is made of.
